bear_case: The most dangerous scenario this morning is not the obvious one. The consensus bear case — hot CPI (+4.0%+) triggering an acute rate spike and selloff — is already priced: VIX at 15.35 and futures at -0.2% are not expressing panic over that tail. The dangerous scenario is 'muddle-through': CPI prints at consensus (~3.8%), Warsh delivers an unsurprising but not-dovish debut statement consistent with the Fed's 3.6% 2026 inflation forecast, and WTI continues to grind toward $76-77 without triggering either the $80 trip wire or a decisive pullback. In this scenario there is no acute shock to force re-hedging, no BUY signal to act on, and no catastrophic catalyst to exit around — just a slow drain as September hike probability drifts from 60% to 70% over two weeks, gradually compressing AI multiples without a clean entry or exit signal. NVDA drifts toward $195 (mandatory stop) without a decisive break; SKHY's 25% allocation loses 8-12% over ten days; BTC holds $62,000 at close but generates no recovery momentum, resetting the Gate 2 test daily. The BTC 24h low of $61,821 this morning is the real-time leading indicator: the crypto market is already pricing the muddle-through macro scenario more honestly than the equity market's muted -0.2% futures. The equity market has historically lagged this signal by 2-5 days when the leading BTC tell is a sustained Gate 2 test under persistent inflation and geopolitical pressure. Invalidation: SPX closes today above 7,575 (July 10 close) with VIX below 15 and BTC above $63,500 — that trifecta signals the market is pricing a soft CPI outcome even before the print, and the regime has shifted to HOLD. If all three clear simultaneously post-CPI: upgrade to BUY on next morning's open.
